latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — a strategic toolkit for transforming biotech science into persuasive investor narratives.

- Translates technical scientific and clinical data into business-focused storytelling for investors.
- Provides modular narrative structures (Problem→Solution→Market→Traction→Vision) tailored for fundraising decks, partnerships, and public market communications.
- Optimizes message depth for all funding stages (seed to IPO) and calibrates for different investor types (VC, pharma, public markets).
- Includes Q&A preparation and framing of scientific/regulatory risk for investor audiences.
- Integrates upstream/downstream with other commercialization and business development tools.
